title: onopordum bracteatum subsp. myriacanthum
intro: Onopordum bracteatum subsp. myriacanthum, commonly known as the Giant Thistle, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family that is native to the Mediterranean region. Research suggests that the Giant Thistle has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the management of conditions such as arthritis and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antispasmodic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Onopordum bracteatum subsp. myriacanthum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
